data.name: Chandrat
data.gender_notes: Chandrat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name derived from the word 'Chandra' meaning moon in Sanskrit. Adopted in Urdu culture. The name Chandrat carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Chandrat usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
